build_scrolly_maze_game: build a scrolling maze game with collectible coins and patroller enemies using ascii art maps
create_player_sprite: create a player sprite that moves through a scrolling maze and avoids walls
create_patroller_sprite: create a patroller sprite that wanders horizontally and terminates the episode on contact with the player
run_scrolly_maze_cli: run the scrolly maze game via command line with an optional level argument selecting level 0, 1, or 2
review_scrolly_drape: review the scrolling drape classes that handle maze walls and coin collection with reward logic
